```{r}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)

naples_grid <- 
  httr2::request("https://api.weather.gov/points/26.1423,-81.7960") |> 
  httr2::req_headers(
    `User-Agent` = "(MyWeatherApp, contact@example.com)"
  ) |> 
  # nothing has been sent yet
  httr2::req_perform() |> 
  httr2::resp_body_string() |> 
  jsonlite::fromJSON()

# Extract the properties object
grid_properties <- naples_grid$properties

# View key grid parameters
cat("Grid ID:", grid_properties$gridId, "\n")
cat("Grid X: ", grid_properties$gridX, "\n")
cat("Grid Y: ", grid_properties$gridY, "\n")
cat("Forecast URL:", grid_properties$forecast, "\n")
```


```{r}
# 1. Read the CSV file
toxic_ips <- read_csv("data/toxic_ips_oct2025.csv")

# 2. Query each IP using the exact httr2 pipeline structure from your notes
ip_df <- map_dfr(toxic_ips$IP, function(ip_addr) {
  httr2::request(paste0("http://ip-api.com/json/", ip_addr)) |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      fields = "status,continent,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,district,zip,lat,lon,timezone,currency,isp,org,as,query"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    httr2::resp_body_string() |>
    jsonlite::fromJSON()
})

dplyr::glimpse(ip_df)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Read the HTML page
page <- rvest::read_html("https://realpython.github.io/fake-jobs/")

# 1. Extract each element one at a time using corrected CSS selectors
title <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("div.card-content h2.title") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

company <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("div.card-content h3.company") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

location <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("div.card-content p.location") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

date_posted <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("div.card-content time") |> 
  rvest::html_text2()

apply_link <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("footer.card-footer a:nth-child(2)") |> 
  rvest::html_attr("href")

# Combine the individual 100-length vectors into a data frame
fake_jobs_df <- tibble(
  title = title,
  company = company,
  location = location,
  date_posted = date_posted,
  apply_link = apply_link
)

# 2. Count job titles containing "Python"
python_jobs_count <- sum(stringr::str_detect(title, stringr::regex("Python", ignore_case = TRUE)))

# View output
dplyr::glimpse(fake_jobs_df)
print(python_jobs_count)
```

toxic_ips <- readr::read_csv("../data/toxic_ips_oct2025.csv")
fields_list <- "status,continent,country,countryCode,region,regionName,city,district,zip,lat,lon,timezone,currency,isp,org,as,query"
ip_df <- purrr::map_dfr(toxic_ips$IP, function(ip_addr) {
  resp <- httr2::request("http://ip-api.com/json/") |> 
    httr2::req_url_path_append(ip_addr) |> 
    httr2::req_url_query(fields = fields_list) |> 
    httr2::req_perform()
  res_json <- resp |> 
    httr2::resp_body_string() |> 
    jsonlite::fromJSON()
  
  as.data.frame(res_json)
})
dplyr::glimpse(ip_df)
